title: Saturday Neon
topic: Meeting friends at the diner, then dancing together on a cheerful Saturday night
style: upbeat retro soul-pop, grooving bass, bright rhythm guitar, handclaps
cover_prompt: A coral and turquoise neon diner sign at dusk, friends silhouetted through the window, joyful vintage atmosphere
lyrics:
[Verse]
Grease stains and laughter fill the booth,
Saturday night feels like a boot.
We slide out, shoes squeak on the floor,
Kickin’ up joy, kickin’ off more.

[Chorus]
Clap your hands, let the bassline roll,
We’re spinning stories that make us whole.
Neon lights and a retro beat,
Dancin’ hard on this Saturday night!
lyrics_source: Qwen class endpoint; passed unchanged to ACE-Step
